#!/bin/bash

# Log file
LOG_FILE="/var/log/git-deploy/post-receive.log"
mkdir -p $(dirname "$LOG_FILE")

{
  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Starting deployment"

  # Temporary checkout directory
  TEMP_DIR="/tmp/git-deploy-$$"
  mkdir -p "$TEMP_DIR"

  # Read the ref update from stdin
  while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=${refname#refs/heads/}

    echo "Processing branch: $branch"

    if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then
      DEPLOY_DIR="/var/www/html"
      echo "Deploying main branch to $DEPLOY_DIR"

      # Clone the specific branch
      git --git-dir=/git/project.git checkout -f -B main "$newrev" -- .
      git --work-tree="$DEPLOY_DIR" --git-dir=/git/project.git checkout -f "$newrev" -- .

      # Verify deployment
      if [ -f "$DEPLOY_DIR/index.html" ]; then
        echo "✓ Main deployment successful"
      else
        echo "✗ Main deployment failed - no index.html"
      fi

    elif [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then
      DEPLOY_DIR="/var/www/html/dev"
      mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_DIR"
      echo "Deploying dev branch to $DEPLOY_DIR"

      # Clone the specific branch
      git --work-tree="$DEPLOY_DIR" --git-dir=/git/project.git checkout -f "$newrev" -- .

      # Verify deployment
      if [ -f "$DEPLOY_DIR/index.html" ]; then
        echo "✓ Dev deployment successful"
      else
        echo "✗ Dev deployment failed - no index.html"
      fi
    fi
  done

  # Cleanup
  rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"

  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Deployment complete"
} >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

exit 0
